# ADR-<NNNN>: <title>

_Linked from [Architecture](../architecture.md) §11. Date: <date>.
Status: proposed | accepted | superseded by ADR-<NNNN>._

## Context

What situation/constraint/problem forced a decision. Enough for someone
with no memory of the discussion to understand why this needed deciding
at all.

## Decision

What was decided, stated plainly in one or two sentences.

## Alternatives considered

For each real alternative: what it was, and specifically why it wasn't
chosen — not a strawman, an option someone genuinely could have argued
for.

## Consequences

What this decision makes easier, what it makes harder, and any follow-up
work it implies. Include the downsides honestly — an ADR that only lists
upsides isn't trustworthy.

## Sources

If this formalizes a decision already reasoned through in a `/plan`
output or a PR discussion, link/reference it here rather than
re-deriving the reasoning from scratch.
